verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs say the Sandbox SDK runs untrusted code securely in isolated environments, with each sandbox in its own VM or isolated container. The docs also position it for AI agents that execute code and offer outbound HTTP interception via Workers. A community comment says outbound network control is all-or-nothing, which questions egress granularity but does not contradict the core isolation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation strength, documented per-sandbox resource limits (CPU/memory caps), and clearly documented fine-grained egress controls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure

citations.quote: The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment, providing strong security boundaries while maintaining performance.
Sandboxes are ideal for building AI agents that need to execute code
Intercept and handle outbound HTTP from sandboxes using Workers.
